front.title: Post-Quantum Authentication and Lifecycle Operations for IoT Deployments Using DNP3 SAv5

abstract.t:
This document addresses post-quantum authentication migration for Internet of Things (IoT) deployments that already use DNP3 Secure Authentication version 5 (SAv5), including fleets of networked outstations and industrial gateways with limited local user interfaces. It describes identity provisioning, admission to authenticated operation, credential and session replacement, failure recovery, quarantine, and retirement under an operator's existing authorization policy.
A cryptographic profile supports these lifecycle operations using an ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA exchange, HKDF-SHA-256 session keys, canonical DNP3 application protocol data unit (APDU) encoding, transport segmentation, and HMAC-SHA-256 application authentication. The profile does not encrypt DNP3 payloads or replace application control authorization.
This individual submission proposes Standards Track publication and requests IOTOPS review of its IoT operational requirements. The appropriate venue for new protocol work requires separate determination. DNP3 object variations and externally allocated algorithm identifiers require coordination with the responsible DNP3 standards authority. The local experimental selector is limited to explicitly configured laboratory use and is not an IEEE or IEC assignment.
